findings.finding: The PR contains no hosted Bucket-01 workflow. Exact-head execution and retained reports must be supplied separately without changing the technical benchmark definitions.

Existing annular T6 generator is evaluated independently for mapped area, radius, centre, ligament, perimeter, boundary deviation, midside placement, rotational symmetry, dense Jacobians, connectivity, shared edges, duplicates and feature sets.
Material, load and restraint coverage must remain separate from pure mesh geometry qualification.
The retained T6 patch covers distorted geometry, rigid motions, scaling, rotation and Jacobian rejection.

A frozen closed-form affine uniaxial-stress oracle and governed T3 receipt now cover plane stress and plane strain, exact nodal displacement, constant element strain and stress, traction-to-nodal load parity, strain energy, force and moment equilibrium, and three deterministic replays at the manifest 1e-8 normalized tolerance.

A frozen closed-form pure-shear oracle and governed T3 receipt now cover plane stress and plane strain, exact affine displacement, engineering shear strain, tau_xy, principal and von Mises stress, strain energy, four-edge traction-to-nodal parity, prescribed-displacement parity through a separate fully imposed model, nontrivial nodal boundary-force reconstruction, force and moment equilibrium, and three deterministic replays at 1e-8 normalized tolerances.

A frozen closed-form plane-stress pure-bending panel oracle and 8/32/128-element T6 benchmark now verify quadratic displacement, linear integration-point stress, deterministic replay, strain energy, zero force resultant and applied/reaction moment equilibrium without smoothed stress.

The 64/256/1024 production ladder now has a frozen load line-of-action and moment oracle, a governed evaluator for force and moment equilibrium, independent half-external-work energy reconstruction, three-level strain-energy Richardson/GCI, a production execution runner, and a retained-result receipt. No production execution receipt is claimed yet.
The exact 1024-element production solve has not been retained. The runner deliberately uses the real LAFEA.3 execution route and does not substitute a test-only sparse or reduced solver.
Fixed element-local probes reconstruct tensor components from retained T6 integration points with no nodal projection or cross-element averaging.
New evaluators provide observed order, Richardson extrapolation, GCI, asymptotic-range checks, oracle-bound invariant resultants and oscillatory/non-monotonic blocking.
Production Kirsch and lug fixed-coordinate receipts are not yet generated.
No governing code, edition, allowable source, classification or independent code oracle is frozen.
The final exact candidate requires three clean deterministic executions with retained report-data hashes.
